# Accounts held per person and holdings against FCA Financial Lives 2024

Files: `account_holdings.pdf`, `account_holdings.svg` (this file: `account_holdings.md`), written by `ob_figures.py` (task T25).

**The data are synthetic.** They were generated by `ob_generator.py` from ONS averages (Family Spending, uprated), FCA Financial Lives 2024 holding rates and stated synthetic assumptions, so this figure describes the generator, not real customers.

## Source data

Source: the 100 files `Analysis/open_banking/persona*.json` (Open Banking Read/Write v3.1 objects; seed 20261107) and `Analysis/open_banking/ground_truth.csv`, written by `ob_generator.py` at commit `0aff08f`; read by `ob_figures.py` (commit `fcf62e6` or later). Plot style: `figstyle.py` (Auro's front-end style) sha256 `91e3bd61f98a`. No random numbers are drawn here (seed: not applicable).

## Filters, transformations and units

All 100 personas. Left: number of accounts per person, `n_accounts` in `ground_truth.csv` (current accounts, joint
account, savings, cash ISA and credit cards each count once). Right: share of persons holding each account type, from
`account_keys` in `ground_truth.csv`, beside the FCA share (the figure shows these two; the model probabilities are in the table only). "Model probability" is the mean over persons of the holding probability the generator
used (`p_savings`, `p_cash_isa`, `p_credit_card`, `p_second_current`, `p_joint`); the FCA column is read from the table in
[`Analysis/open_banking/summary.md`](../../Analysis/open_banking/summary.md) (FCA Financial Lives 2024, weighted data tables, base all UK adults).
The FCA second-current-account figure is a derived lower bound (sum of provider-group shares minus 1); the FCA main-current
figure is any current account (0.97); the FCA card figure is any credit card. No FCA rate exists for joint accounts
(a synthetic rule: half of couples). Plotted data: [`Analysis/open_banking_figures/accounts_per_person.csv`](../../Analysis/open_banking_figures/accounts_per_person.csv)
and [`account_holdings.csv`](../../Analysis/open_banking_figures/account_holdings.csv).

## Statistics

Counts and shares only; there are no error bars, tests or fits (not applicable). For a holding probability p, the binomial standard
deviation of a share out of 100 persons is sqrt(p(1 - p)/100), at most 5 percentage points, so differences of a few points between the
generated share and the model probability are within sampling noise (stated, not tested).

## Interpretation

Most persons hold three or four accounts (29 and 33 of 100). Generated holdings of savings accounts and cash ISAs are close to the FCA rates that parameterised them (57% and 31% against 57% and 32%).
Credit-card holding is higher than the FCA rate (generated 82%, model 75%, FCA 65%), and
the second-current-account holding (38%) exceeds the FCA lower bound (27%); in both cases the generator's holding
probabilities combine age and income rates and a stated synthetic second-card rule, and do not reproduce the all-adult totals. Agreement
where it occurs is by construction and is not independent validation.
